2609.24831.title: GRUET: Quantifying Uncertainty of Agentic Reasoning-and-Acting Processes
2609.24831.paper_summary: Agents have attracted considerably increasing attention due to the power of executing both Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) in open and dynamic environments. The ReAct process typically exhibits a multi-turn trajectory in which one drives Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate both reasoning chains and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. However, agents often suffer from significant uncertainty, where identical tasks yield divergent trajectories; trajectories with higher uncertainty often produce incomprehensible behaviors, severely undermining agent credibility. This work conjectures that such trajectory-level uncertainty frequently stems from cumulative turn-level reasoning uncertainty induced by LLMs; the latter often exhibits a collection of branches of divergent reasoning chains and their resulting actions. Built upon this, we present the Graph-based Reasoning UncErtainty in Trajectories (GRUET) method for the uncertainty quantification of ReAct, comprising turn-level reasoning uncertainty quantification and trajectory-level uncertainty aggregation; the former precisely quantifies reasoning uncertainty via modeling the reasoning space spanned by potential reasoning branches as a graph and then approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity, while the latter employs simple aggregation strategies for quantifying the overall trajectory credibility. Empirical evaluations across nine LLMs and five benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed GRUET in terms of selective generation performance, measured by AUROC, AUPRC, and AUARC.
2609.24831.paper_summary_zh: 代理人因其在開放和動態環境中執行推理與行動（ReAct）的能力而受到越來越多的關注。ReAct過程通常表現出多回合的軌跡，其中驅動大型語言模型（LLMs）以交錯的方式生成推理鏈和任務特定的行動。然而，代理人經常面臨顯著的不確定性，相同的任務會產生不同的軌跡；不確定性較高的軌跡往往會產生難以理解的行為，嚴重削弱代理人的可信度。本研究推測，這種軌跡級別的不確定性通常源於LLMs引起的累積回合級別推理不確定性；後者通常表現出一組分歧推理鏈及其相應的行動。在此基礎上，我們提出了基於圖的推理不確定性量化方法（GRUET），用於ReAct的不確定性量化，包含回合級推理不確定性量化和軌跡級不確定性聚合；前者通過將潛在推理分支所跨越的推理空間建模為圖，然後用圖的複雜度來近似推理空間的複雜度，精確量化推理不確定性，而後者則採用簡單的聚合策略來量化整體軌跡的可信度。對九個LLMs和五個基準的實證評估驗證了我們提出的GRUET在選擇性生成性能方面的有效性，該性能以AUROC、AUPRC和AUARC進行測量。
